ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central mass with high-intensity white pigmentation concentrated at the distal tips and as irregular mottling on the left lobe. A distinct, high-intensity circular blob is located in the lower-left quadrant of the central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box recession.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks is greatest on the distal half of the right lobe lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge, transitioning to sharp convex points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular high-contrast rings (dark centers with white perimeters) on the medial-right lobe, and white crustose clusters (barnacles) on the terminal points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive distribution of parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on both lobes, with highest density in the central-left and upper-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense accumulation of parallel linear rake marks and circular parasitic/bite scars across the ventral surface; heavy barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated white circular patch (approximately 5% of lobe height) located in the lower interior region of the left lobe.
